description: NaDySe₂ is Caswellsilverite structured and crystallizes in the trigonal R̅3m space group. Na¹⁺ is bonded to six equivalent Se²⁻ atoms to form NaSe₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent DySe₆ octahedra, edges with six equivalent NaSe₆ octahedra, and edges with six equivalent DySe₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 4°. All Na-Se bond lengths are 3.02 Å. Dy³⁺ is bonded to six equivalent Se²⁻ atoms to form DySe₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent NaSe₆ octahedra, edges with six equivalent NaSe₆ octahedra, and edges with six equivalent DySe₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 4°. All Dy-Se bond lengths are 2.87 Å. Se²⁻ is bonded to three equivalent Na¹⁺ and three equivalent Dy³⁺ atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing SeNa₃Dy₃ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted.
